title: eludite/build/cancel
description: Cancel the running build: the host kills the MSBuild process tree and sends eludite/build/finished with result `canceled` within 2 s. Canceling when no build runs (or naming another build) changes nothing.

params.description: Optionally the build to cancel; omitted, null or empty: the running one.

buildId.description: The build's id, unique within one host process, from 1.

canceled.description: True when a running build is being canceled; its eludite/build/finished follows.
